owner: CC (code+proofs); Akien (design: the first-face frame — 'learning always and summarizing when asked'; web_server as the carrier)
intention: The CHAT FACE — the conversational surface over the loop and the transducer (cairn/devices/librarian/chat.py), the LAST stone of the ratified chain: the librarian is now a chatbot. The face adds NO third mechanism: LEARNING ALWAYS is every turn crossing the core loop (the reply is the graph's WALK, never the generate text; a miss backfills and the original question resubmits through structure), and SUMMARIZING WHEN ASKED is the `summarize:` prefix routing to the transducer. THE ROUTE IS PHYSICS, NOT A GUESSED INTENT: a stated affordance, matched deterministically, zero inference spent classifying the utterance. A verb's loud refusal becomes a legible REPLY the session survives. The transcript is runtime state and dies with the process; the graph is the memory that survives it — which is what makes follow-ups immediate across sessions, not just across turns. THE CARRIER (corrected 2026-07-28): there is ONLY EVER ONE WEB SERVER in the system — the librarian owns a PAGE the extant web server displays. Its chat window is a surface the base shim class understands: LibrarianDevice DECLARES the chat pane (cairn/devices/librarian/shim.py's LibrarianShim rides the roster, wakes the device on the first poke and attaches the live face), and a POSTed utterance travels web_server → shim.deliver → device.receive. No chat route, no injected chat source, no second door; the web listener (listener.py, renamed from daemon.py) acts only on external calls — NO DAEMONS.
why: Akien's first-face ruling, 2026-07-27, verbatim: 'the current goal is the librarian as chat bot, learning, and summarizing. learning always and summarizing when asked' ... 'we can also ask deeper questions from [the summary]... And he'll already be ready to answer them immediately. This is part of orienting, for anything externally facing.' The go for this stone: 'The word is given. Warp speed.' The carrier was CC's read on the parent ticket ('web_server exists and can carry it — unratified') and the go ratified it: web_server's own charter said its why was 'the librarian needs a web interface, and a web interface falls out of the chatbot only if the surface exists first' — this stone is that sentence coming true. The route-as-physics choice traces Akien's standing frame: an intent guess is an unmeasured hypothesis steering a real host call (Law 3), and the prefix affordance is SAID on the surface so nobody memorizes it (build-to-the-tool).
traces_to: Law 1 — a warm turn spends NOTHING: no generate for the answer (the walk is the reply), none for routing (the prefix is physics); the same question in a later turn is a walk, zero backfills — the chat's memory is the graph, chat teeth pin all three
Law 3 — every reply carries its measurements: the verdict shows best-vs-floor, the summary shows reached-vs-exists; the surface renders them, never rounds them away

Law 6 — the surface owns nothing: the transcript is the session's, the knowledge is the tree's (librarian-owned, db_domain-gated), the web_server only carries; chat.py's import allowlist is loop + summarize + trees — the face composes, it opens no door

Law 7 — a refusal is a reply the session survives (raw carried whole by the verb, rendered loudly); a dying turn is a legible 500 whose breadcrumb records the 500 the page collapsed; every librarian string is escaped at the surface

Law 8 — a chatbot wearing a librarian's charter (the parent's named wrong-shape: answers from inference, not structure) cannot pass the teeth: the reply IS the walk, and the proof asserts the generate text never surfaces

distinctions_recorded: THE CHAIN IS CLOSED: five stones, each fired individually by Akien, all cast and PROVED within the same arc — graph-tree store, core loop, library+learn, summarizer, chat surface. The first face is whole: a human can open a browser, ask, and every answer comes from structure.

THE FIRST LIVE CONVERSATION (through the browser door, library tree): (1) asked why Akien wanted an audit agent — RESOLVED by walk alone at 0.6772, ZERO backfills, and stone 4's landed summary rode the walk mid-rank as ordinary structure (the deposit-back earning its keep in the very next session); (2) 'summarize: the audit agent and watchdog ideas...' rendered cited prose from 8 of 34 nodes — two shelved passages and four backfill mints, each citation legible by source; (3) a question the library tree genuinely lacks (the hex payback meter) backfilled three path-shaped mints and RESOLVED at 0.8295 on them.

EDGE (l)'s SECOND FACE, MEASURED: home-field advantage does not just outrank real nodes — it can MANUFACTURE resolution where the graph held nothing. The payback-meter mints were content-wrong about the actual idea, yet satisfied the floor because they were born question-shaped. Traceable throughout (source: llm-backfill, standing: hypothesis), so the verdict is honest about its sources — but a consumer reading only the verdict line would call it answered. Filed on the librarian charter (edge l, second face) with a third customer for the tenure loop: cross-tree resolution (the founding tree COULD have answered that question).

THE CARRIER WAS ALREADY TRUE: web_server's charter (2026-07-22) said the librarian's web interface 'falls out of the chatbot only if the surface exists first' — five days later the chat window landed as its filed edge (c)'s first rich view: a PANE the standard machinery renders on the librarian's own page.

CC-- 2026-07-28, THE CARRIER WAS FIRST BUILT WRONG-SHAPED: the first cast wired chat as a bespoke /chat route with an injected chat_source — a parallel door, when the ratified design already had the machinery (Akien, verbatim: 'there should be ONLY EVER ONE WEB SERVER IN THE WHOLE SYSTEM... the librarian would have a page it manages that the extant web server would display. it's chat window is supposed to be in the surfaces the base shim class understands' — and 'the shims job is to start it's device if it's not running'). Corrected same-day to the pane + shim shape; the /chat route removed (a proof tooth now pins that it 404s); daemon.py renamed listener.py with the NO DAEMONS law stated in its charter-docstring (it acts only on external calls — UU's daemon sprawl is WHY the ground loop owns the one heartbeat). The drift's shape: I paralleled the harbor exception (a fleet-wide injected view) for what is really a DEVICE surface — the harbor route is the exception, the pane machinery is the rule.

A LIVE REFUSAL EXPOSED A PARSER DEFECT (found by the corrected shape's live fire, 2026-07-28): qwen2.5:7b cited [1, 6] — comma-grouped, one bracket, two anchors — and the single-number marker pattern refused a genuinely anchored draft as 'anchors to nothing'. Fixed as the fence precedent: grouping is a presentation quirk, not content ([1, 6] anchors passages 1 and 6; an out-of-range member of a group is still a minted citation — new tooth pins both). The re-fire consumed the CACHED draft and landed cited prose with zero new inference: the fix turned a cached refusal into a cached success (Law 1 whole through a bug fix).
